title: The Art of Acquiescence
coreMove: Stop wasting force against what has already happened and redirect that force into the conduct still available.
sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Will, so it must teach endurance, acceptance, and inner governance when control is partial. No source sidecar exists for ch23; this plan is grounded in the frozen TOC title and part placement only, with no named anecdotes invented. For "The Art of Acquiescence", the pressure is to teach this exact move: Stop wasting force against what has already happened and redirect that force into the conduct still available.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into vague toughness or acceptance slogans instead of disciplined endurance under partial control. For "The Art of Acquiescence", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.
